import polars as pl

# Create sample DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "a": [3, 6, 8, 5],
    "b": [4, 5, 3, 6]
})

# Define row-wise callback
def check_sum(row):
    return "hi" if row["a"] + row["b"] > 10 else "lo"

# Apply callback using map_rows
result = df.with_columns(
    pl.struct(["a", "b"]).map_rows(check_sum).alias("result")
)

print(result)
